result.title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
result.summary: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TriPhysBench，含 410 道题、源自 200 个视频，评测具身智能体在物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理上的协同；并提出 TriPhys，从完整的工具整合轨迹中学习统一策略，用中间推理引导检索与计算，再把工具反馈纳入后续物理推断。
AI.relevance_reason: 「中间推理引导证据获取、工具反馈回注后续推理」的轨迹训练，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、推理状态更新与轨迹监督的贡献分配；但基准本身偏具身物理问答，与 latent 表示机制联系较间接。
